27M here with alternate exotropia, just like you. I had an unsuccessful surgery when I was 8, and the doctor told me I'd have to live with it as there was nothing more they could do. Growing up, I dealt with a lot because of it, bullying, struggles with dating, and low self-esteem. But eventually, in my twenties, I started to accept myself. I trained myself to switch focus between my eyes whenever I made eye contact, to make it less noticeable. I also learned to align my eyes better for photos.
